description: This file defines an immutable implementation of a JSON object within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It provides methods for creating, modifying, querying, and serializing JSON objects in an immutable manner, and manages internal representations efficiently using caching and soft references. The class includes nested classes for internal data handling and parsing functionality.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON object that supports creating modified copies, querying data, and serialization with internal caching for efficiency.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject.SoftReferencedFieldMap
classes.description: A cache-aware internal class managing the map of JSON fields with lazy parsing and efficient memory usage via soft references, supporting serialization and hash code calculation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject.FieldMapJsonHandler
classes.description: A thread-unsafe JSON handler used for parsing JSON strings into a Map of JsonFields, supporting nested object parsing.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty JSON object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonObject with specified fields, optionally with known string or CBOR representations.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods for setting a value (primitive or JsonValue) for a specified key, returning a new modified JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField or a value specified by a field definition, returning a new JSON object with the modification.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple fields to the JSON object, returning an updated new object.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether the JSON object contains a key or path specified by a pointer.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key or path, optionally with a specific type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves nested JSON objects or values based on a pointer or field definition.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonField for a given key or path.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field specified by key or path, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all keys in the JSON object.
